summary: Scene-culling test of a bounding sphere (center at this+0x7C/0x80/0x84, radius at this+0x18) against the caller-supplied view frustum a2. A force-hidden flag mask (this+0x4 bits 4/6) short-circuits to culled; otherwise a bounding-sphere distance test prunes the object, then all six frustum planes are tested. The visibility result is written into the low status bits of this+0x4. Part of the scene culling system.

local_names.a2: frustum description: bounding sphere radius at a2[2], sphere offset at a2[9..11], six plane blocks starting at a2+65
local_names.v4: sphere center X relative to the frustum bounding volume
local_names.v6: sphere center Y relative to the frustum bounding volume
local_names.v7: sphere center Z relative to the frustum bounding volume
local_names.v11: signed distance from the sphere center to the current frustum plane
local_names.v9: plane counter over the six frustum planes

operations.description: Load flags at this+0x4; when (flags & 0x50) is non-zero the object is force-hidden, so set bit 1 (culled) via flags | 2 and return 0.
Compute the sphere center relative to the frustum bounding volume: cx = a2[9] + *(this+0x7C), cy = a2[10] + *(this+0x80), cz = a2[11] + *(this+0x84).
Clear the four low status bits of this+0x4: flags & 0xFFFFFFF0.
Bounding-sphere distance test: when sqrt(cx*cx + cy*cy + cz*cz) - radius(this+0x18) exceeds a2[2], set bit 3 (sphere-culled) via flags | 8 and return 0.
Iterate the six frustum plane equation blocks starting at a2 + 65, advancing 4 floats per plane.
For each plane compute the signed distance v11 = -(nx * cx) - (ny * cy) - (nz * cz) - d from the plane coefficients.
When v11 > radius(this+0x18) the sphere is fully outside this plane: set bit 1 (culled) via flags & 0xFFFFFFFC | 2 and return 0.
When v11 > -radius(this+0x18) the sphere straddles this plane, so break out of the plane loop.
If the plane counter reaches 6 without a straddle or outside case, the sphere was inside every plane: return 0 as fully visible.
After the plane loop, set bit 2 (partial visibility): this+0x4 = flags & 0xFFFFFFFA | 4, then return 0.

unresolved: The frustum argument a2 layout (bounding radius at a2[2], sphere offset at a2[9..11], plane block at a2+65) is caller-defined; only the used indices are evidenced here.
The bit semantics of the visibility flags at this+0x4 beyond the force-hidden 0x50 mask are inferred from the branch structure, not independently confirmed.
